status_vocabulary.CANDIDATE: Chosen for purchasing and physical evaluation, but not released.
status_vocabulary.CANDIDATE_SELECTED: Included in the intended V1 scope and selected in the canonical route record, but still unqualified and unreleased.
status_vocabulary.OUT_OF_V1: Intentionally excluded from the first product configuration.
status_vocabulary.OPEN: A product decision or exact purchasable item is still unresolved.
status_vocabulary.PHYSICAL_QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED: A real item must be measured and tested against the controlled acceptance method.

status_policy: This file is a pre-hardware configuration record, not manufacturing or customer release authority.
A nominal dimension, vendor specification, CAD fit, or calculated load never completes physical qualification.
A true selected-route boolean records intended V1 scope only; it does not satisfy any measurement, lifecycle, physical-qualification, or release gate.

product.name: RoCell RC03 Self-Print Hybrid Kit for QIDI Plus4
product.format: Customer-printed plastic parts plus a seller-supplied labeled hardware, safety, fiducial, spring, and reinforcement pack.
product.target_customer: Existing QIDI Plus4 owner with normal maker and hand-tool skills.
product.scope_note: The robot, printer, reference keyboard, bare phone, computer, and structural board remain customer-owned unless the commercial BOM later reclassifies them.

notes: The protected envelope is a conservative design candidate already encoded in config/parameters.json and config/workcell_layout.json.
Measure the reference machine in X, Y, and Z, including carriage, enclosure, purge, plate-edge, and first-layer exclusions before release.
The Plus4 is discontinued in some QIDI regional stores; V1 therefore targets existing owners unless supply/support strategy changes.

structural_board.fabrication: Purchased or hand-cut rectangle, sealed, then hand drilled from a released 1:1 guide; no router or CNC.
open_items: Exact supplier/SKU or allowable material range
Anchor system and all nine fastener stacks
Exact reinforcement plate, feet, anti-shift system, and E-stop assembly

keyboard.reference_variant_candidate: PERIBOARD-409 U, USB Type-A, English (US), black
notes: Confirm the purchased unit label, layout, connector, cable exit, underside feet, key field, and full physical envelope.
No other PERIBOARD-409 connector/layout variant is included without separate compatibility evidence.
Confirm the exact regional model and measure the body, buttons, glass edge, camera bump, port, and installed orientation.
A case is OUT_OF_V1 for this candidate and requires a later compatibility configuration.

phone_usb_cable.configuration: USB-C to USB-C, right-angle device end to straight host end, 1 m, USB 2.0 480 Mbps, up to 60 W / 3 A
open_items: Confirm the intended host/power source provides the required USB-C interface and power behavior.
The manufacturer does not publish a minimum installed bend radius; measure the relaxed bend and connector projection.
Prove the right-angle direction clears the bare-phone cradle and creates no lateral port load.

camera.published_mount: Integrated tripod thread; exact usable blind depth is unpublished
camera.height_calculation_note: Engineering starting range inferred from 43.3 degree vertical FOV, a 457 mm board depth, and about 10 percent framing margin; it is not a released mast datum.
open_items: Measure the actual camera and tripod-thread blind depth and prove a non-bottoming fastener stack or strap route.
Prove focus and exposure can be controlled and remain stable after disconnect/reconnect and application restart.
Prove all six tags are detected in every required acceptance pose with the final mast and lighting.

camera_architecture_alignment.user_intended_primary_architecture: Arm-mounted camera per the intended camera specification
camera_architecture_alignment.current_controlled_architecture: Fixed overhead eye-to-hand camera on the independent 2020 mast route
notes: The exact arm-mounted camera specification and mounting interface are not present in the current RC03 package.
The Logitech C920e and paired 2020 mast remain candidates for fixed-overhead fallback evaluation only; they are not substitutes for the missing arm-camera specification.
Jobs 03C3, 06, 07A, and 07B carry the fixed_camera_fallback_architecture_released prerequisite and cannot become READY while the architecture hold remains open.
Arm mounting changes payload, reach, collisions, cable flex, occlusion, calibration architecture, and Step 13 acceptance and therefore requires controlled revision before manufacture or powered use.

camera_support.architecture: Paired 2020 extrusion mast isolated from the robot; selected unqualified fallback while the user-intended arm-mounted architecture is on engineering alignment hold
notes: The route is selected in config/measurement_record.json as intended V1 scope, but remains physically unqualified and unreleased pending the explicit fixed-camera architecture gate, hardware, and evidence.
Qualify extrusion fit, both feet, all M5 stacks, crossbar level, base attachment, static rigidity, cable disturbance, and 24-hour stability.

tool_spring.calculation_note: Incremental loads are spring-rate calculations before assembly preload, friction, tolerance, or off-axis effects.
open_items: Measure actual OD, ID/work-over-rod clearance, free length, solid height, and rate/force curve.
Prove 1-6 mm travel, preload, no coil bind, no guide rub, full return, creep, and route-specific contact force.
Reject or redesign if the final approved force envelope cannot be met.

v1_contact_tool.architecture: 6 mm rigid rod, printed 6-to-9 mm bushing, and replaceable TPU keyboard tip in the shared compliant body
notes: Measure the exact rod and qualify bushing retention, TPU pull-off/creep, spring force/travel, keyboard function, and TCP repeatability.
This pre-hardware intent does not alter config/measurement_record.json route booleans.

phone_stylus_route.architecture: Passive capacitive stylus held by a printed collar in the shared compliant body
open_items: Select one exact passive stylus manufacturer/model and record its full geometry and material construction.
Qualify job 00D gauge selection, job 04B collar, dry or removable-compound retention, pull/cycle/removal/creep behavior, phone contact force, touch reliability, and TCP repeatability.
phone_stylus_route.scope_note: The route is intentionally selected for V1 evaluation, but no stylus hardware, printed adapter, retention method, contact result, or software behavior is physically qualified or released.
